title: Quaint Light Algerian Chicken Liver Wrap
description: A pungent and light Algerian dish featuring chicken liver, served in a mason jar with ssam wrap, ovo-vegetarian friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced chicken liver to the bowl and toss to coat.
Spread the chicken liver mixture on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.
While the chicken liver is cooking, heat a pan over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the minced garlic to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
Once the chicken liver is done, let it cool for a few minutes.
Assemble the wrap by placing a piece of ssam wrap in the bottom of a mason jar, followed by a slice of chicken liver, some sauteed onion and garlic, and a slice of hard boiled egg.
Repeat the layers until the jar is full, ending with a piece of ssam wrap on top.
